name: engineering-harness
description: Risk-proportional architecture, durability, compatibility, hardening, and release workflows for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Make consequential changes safer without burdening simple work.
interface.longDescription: Bootstrap or adopt repositories, route ordinary changes proportionally, and harden demonstrated architecture divergence with exact evidence.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap this repository with the smallest useful engineering harness.
Adopt this existing repository and propose an evidence-backed capability profile.
Route this change proportionally, or harden it only if recurring architecture friction is demonstrated.
